title: SmartBuffer: Intelligent Data Movement in Memory Hierarchies
problem: Data movement across memory hierarchies becomes inefficient with irregular access patterns, leading to high cache miss rates. Traditional cache policies fail to adapt to unpredictable data access behaviors.
motivation: Reducing cache misses through intelligent prefetching and data placement is critical for improving system performance and energy efficiency.
method: SmartBuffer uses predictive analytics to anticipate future data access patterns and proactively manage data movement across the memory hierarchy. The system prefetches data into appropriate cache levels based on predicted access sequences, targeting irregular access patterns where conventional prefetchers underperform.
key_novelty: Applying predictive analytics to anticipate irregular data access patterns and dynamically orchestrate data movement across memory hierarchies.
contributions: Predictive analytics framework for data access pattern forecasting
Intelligent data movement strategy reducing cache misses by 35% on irregular patterns
Adaptive prefetching mechanism for unpredictable workloads
